<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check where the charcoal spots are relative to green diamonds
seg = current_frame.segmentation
charcoal = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'g']
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

print("Charcoal spots:")
for n in charcoal:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    print(f"  center=({sum(rows)//len(rows)}, {sum(cols)//len(cols)})")

print("\nGreen diamonds:")
for n in greens:
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    print(f"  center=({center_r}, {center_c})")

# The charcoal spots form a diamond. Let me find the center of that diamond
# and see which green diamond is closest
if charcoal:
    all_rows = []
    all_cols = []
    for n in charcoal:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_rows.append(p[0])
            all_cols.append(p[1])
    center_r = sum(all_rows) // len(all_rows)
    center_c = sum(all_cols) // len(all_cols)
    print(f"\nCharcoal diamond center: ({center_r}, {center_c})")
    
    # Find closest green diamond
    for n in greens:
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        gr = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        gc = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        dist = abs(gr - center_r) + abs(gc - center_c)
        print(f"  Dist to green ({gr}, {gc}): {dist}")

# Try clicking the green diamond at (19, 36) - closest to charcoal center
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 19, 'col': 36}])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
